strings.greet: Namaste! I'm Accel Saathi, your business advisor from Accel. Tell me about your business in a line, for example "I run a dental clinic in Pune with 12 staff". You can also share your GSTIN and I'll fill in the details for you.
strings.ask_business_type: What kind of business do you run?
strings.ask_city: Which city or town is your business in?
strings.ask_employees: How many people work in your business, including you?
strings.ask_sites: How many shops, branches or locations do you have?
strings.ask_gstin: Do you have a GST number? Sharing it gives you instant, paper-free verification and unlocks WhatsApp and SMS business tools.
strings.ask_needs: Businesses like yours usually need these. Untick anything you don't need, then tap Continue.
strings.gstin_found: Found it: {name}, {city} ({status}). I've filled in your details.
strings.gstin_inactive: This GSTIN is {status} in the GST registry, so I can't use it for GST-only products. You can still get internet, mobile and more.
strings.gstin_invalid: That GSTIN doesn't look right: {reason}. Please check and type it again, or tap "No GSTIN yet".
strings.gstin_not_found: That GSTIN is valid in format but not in the GST registry. Please re-check it, or continue without it.
strings.no_gstin_ok: No problem. I'll recommend products that don't need a GSTIN. You can add it later.
strings.summary: For your {business} in {city} with {employees} people, here is my recommendation: {count} services in one bill for ₹{monthly}/month (+GST), live in about {days} days.
strings.ready: Here's your bundle. Tell me here if you want it cheaper or want to add or remove anything, or tap See my bundle & price to continue.
strings.why_sites: for businesses with 3 or more locations
strings.why_dependency: needs a broadband or leased line in the same bundle
strings.r_conn_micro: Fast 100 Mbps fibre so UPI, card payments and video calls don't drop.
strings.r_conn_prof: 300 Mbps fibre for your whole team, with an optional static IP.
strings.r_conn_prof_large: 1 Gbps fibre with priority support for a large office.
strings.r_conn_multi: The same fibre plan at every location, on one bill.
strings.r_conn_no_fibre: 5G AirFiber needs no cable and is plug-and-play, ready in about 2 days.
strings.r_conn_mfg: A dedicated leased line with a 99.5% uptime guarantee for your production floor.
strings.r_conn_mfg_heavy: A 100 Mbps dedicated line with a 99.9% uptime guarantee for a large plant.
strings.r_mobile_micro: Business mobile lines with 50 GB data and unlimited calls.
strings.r_mobile_pro: Business lines with 150 GB, roaming and priority care for key staff.
strings.r_pos: GST-ready billing with UPI and card acceptance on a tablet.
strings.r_whatsapp: A verified WhatsApp channel to share your catalogue and take orders.
strings.r_sms: Bulk SMS for reminders and offers, with DLT registration done for you.
strings.r_cctv: HD cameras with 30-day cloud recording you can watch on your phone.
strings.r_email: Email on your own domain, plus documents and video meetings.
strings.r_endpoint: Protects your PCs and phones from viruses and ransomware.
strings.r_backup: Automatic 1 TB backup so you never lose patient or client files.
strings.r_website: A ready website with your own domain so customers can find you online.
strings.r_guest_wifi: A separate Wi-Fi for customers, kept apart from your billing systems.
strings.r_failover: Backup 4G/5G that switches on by itself if the main line goes down.
strings.r_sdwan: Manage the internet at all locations from one screen.
strings.r_telephony: Business phone lines with IVR and call recording.
strings.r_tollfree: A 1800 number customers can call for free.
strings.r_static_ip: A fixed IP so you can view cameras or reach your systems remotely.
strings.r_firewall: A managed firewall watched by Accel's security team.
strings.r_iot: Sensors that track machine uptime and power use.
strings.r_fleet: Live GPS tracking for your vehicles.
strings.r_dependency_added: Added because your other services need an internet line.
strings.r_alt_for: Recommended instead of {name}, which isn't available for you yet.
strings.ask_gstin_type: Great, please type your 15-character GSTIN. I'll fill in your business details from it.
strings.cheaper_done: Done: {changes}. Your bundle is now ₹{new}/month instead of ₹{old} (+GST).
strings.cheaper_floor: This is already the leanest bundle for your business ({items}). Going lower would mean dropping the internet line or the phones you asked for.
strings.budget_short: The lowest I can go while keeping {kept} is ₹{new}/month. Tell me if you want to drop one of these too.
strings.not_in_bundle: {names} isn't in your bundle, so nothing to remove.
strings.keep_internet: Internet is the base of every bundle, so I have to keep it. I can make it cheaper instead.
strings.no_change: Your bundle stays the same at ₹{new}/month.
strings.undo_done: Back to your previous bundle at ₹{new}/month.
strings.welcome_back: Welcome back! Your bundle is below. I can make it cheaper, add or remove a service, switch to 24 months, or answer any question.
strings.help_done: I can change this bundle for you: make it cheaper, add or remove a service, or switch to 24 months. You can also ask me anything about the services, documents or installation.
strings.go_quote: Great! Opening your bundle and price.
strings.go_track: Opening your order tracker. Type your order number there.
strings.callback_ask: Sure. Type your mobile number and a local Accel partner who speaks your language will call you.
strings.callback_ok: Thanks! A local Accel partner will call you on {phone}. Your chat and bundle are saved, so you won't have to repeat anything.
strings.faq_kyc: For KYC you need your GST certificate, Udyam certificate, an address proof less than 90 days old (like an electricity bill) and the signatory's PAN or Aadhaar. Partnerships, LLPs and companies also need an authorisation letter. You can skip uploads by fetching documents from DigiLocker or using Aadhaar OTP.
strings.faq_time: Your bundle should be fully live in about {days} days after KYC. You can book the technician's slot yourself in the tracker.
strings.faq_time_generic: Most services go live within 2 to 7 days after KYC; a leased line takes longer. You can book the technician's slot yourself in the tracker.
strings.faq_privacy: We ask your consent before reading any document. Photos are deleted right after the details are read, ID numbers are masked, and you can erase your data before ordering.
strings.faq_price: Your bundle is ₹{monthly}/month plus 18% GST (₹{gst}), with a one-time setup of ₹{setup}. On {alt_term} months it would be ₹{alt}/month.
strings.faq_price_pending: I'll show your exact price as soon as I know a little more about your business.
strings.faq_gst: Without a GSTIN you can still get internet, mobile, CCTV, POS and more. Toll-free numbers, SMS, cloud telephony, SD-WAN, firewall and some other business products need an active GSTIN.
strings.wa_change_needs: Type the services you need, for example "billing and CCTV, no WhatsApp". I'll build the bundle from that.
strings.noted_lean: Noted, price matters. I'll keep your bundle to what you really need and show you the cheapest sensible option.
strings.noted_budget: Noted, I'll aim to keep it within ₹{budget} a month.
strings.ask_current: Last question: what do you use for internet today?
strings.cur_hotspot: You run on a phone hotspot today; a fibre line stays steady even when the card machine, billing and phones are all online.
strings.cur_home: You use home broadband today; a business line puts internet, phones and the rest on one bill, with one place to ask for help.
strings.cur_business: You already have business broadband; moving it here puts everything on one bill, with one place to ask for help.
strings.cur_leased: You have a leased line today. If your work can't stop even for a minute, ask me about a dedicated line with a written uptime promise.
strings.cur_none: You don't have internet yet, so we'll set everything up from scratch.
strings.cur_spend: You pay about ₹{spend} a month today; this bundle is ₹{monthly} for {count} services.
strings.gstin_confirm: I found this on the GST registry: {name}, {city} ({status}). Is this your business?
strings.gstin_confirmed: Thanks, I've filled in your business details from the registry.
strings.gstin_wrong: No problem, I won't use that GSTIN. Type the right one, or tap No GSTIN yet.
strings.skip_answer: {plain}: {reason} {skip} Taking it out saves ₹{save} a month (about ₹{day} a day).
strings.skip_you_asked: You asked for this yourself, so I've kept it in.
strings.skip_internet: The internet line is the base of your bundle: everything else runs on it, so it has to stay. I can move you to a cheaper line instead.
strings.skip_which: Only the internet line is required; everything else is optional. Ask me about any service, for example "can I skip CCTV?", and I'll tell you what you'd lose and save.
strings.skip_not_in_bundle: {plain} isn't in your bundle, so you're not paying for it.
strings.need_offer: {plain}: {does} Adding it costs ₹{add} a month more (about ₹{day} a day).
strings.kept: Okay, nothing changed. Your bundle stays at ₹{new}/month.
strings.term_answer_12: Same services either way; only the commitment changes. On 12 months you pay ₹{m12}/month. On 24 months it's ₹{m24}/month: ₹{save} less every month and ₹{total} over two years, but you commit for two years.
strings.term_answer_24: You're on 24 months at ₹{m24}/month, the lowest price. On 12 months it would be ₹{m12}/month, and you'd commit for only one year.
strings.term_exit: For the terms of leaving early, tap Talk to a person and a local partner will explain them.
strings.money_setup: Every month: ₹{monthly} + 18% GST (₹{gst}) = ₹{with_gst}. The first bill also has the one-time setup of ₹{setup} plus GST, so it comes to ₹{first}. On {alt_term} months the monthly price would be ₹{alt}.
strings.money_nosetup: Every month: ₹{monthly} + 18% GST (₹{gst}) = ₹{with_gst}. There's no setup fee, so your first bill is also ₹{with_gst}. On {alt_term} months the monthly price would be ₹{alt}.
strings.money_itc: As a GST-registered business, you can usually claim this GST back as input tax credit.
strings.safe_files_have: Your files: automatic backup keeps a copy of your PCs' and phones' files in the cloud (1 TB), so a broken or stolen PC doesn't mean lost records.
strings.safe_files_offer: Your files: automatic backup (₹{price}/month) can keep a copy of your PCs' and phones' files in the cloud, so a broken or stolen PC doesn't mean lost records. It isn't in your bundle yet.
strings.safe_av_have: Antivirus on each device blocks viruses and ransomware.
strings.safe_av_offer: Antivirus that blocks viruses and ransomware is ₹{price} a month per device.
strings.safe_kyc: Your documents: we read them only after your consent, delete photos right after reading them, mask ID numbers, and you can erase your data before ordering (DPDP Act, 2023).
strings.down_have: Your bundle has backup internet: if the main line goes down, a data SIM takes over by itself, so billing and UPI keep working.
strings.down_offer: If the main line goes down, backup internet switches to a data SIM by itself, so billing and UPI keep working. It costs ₹{price} a month per location plus ₹{setup} one-time, and it isn't in your bundle yet.
strings.down_sla: Your {name} also comes with a written uptime promise of {sla}.
strings.down_help: If anything stops working, raise a ticket in the order tracker, and a local partner can call you.
strings.competitor: Fair question. I can't see the details of that plan, but here's what your ₹{monthly}/month gets you:
strings.options_line: Want fewer or more services? Basic is ₹{basic}/month and Complete is ₹{complete}/month; tap one to switch.
strings.options_line_basic: Want only the essentials? Basic is ₹{basic}/month; tap it to switch.
strings.options_line_complete: Want everything businesses like yours use? Complete is ₹{complete}/month; tap it to switch.
strings.take_up: {n} in 10 similar businesses on Accel have this.
strings.gloss_mbps: Mbps is internet speed. More Mbps lets more people and devices use the internet at once without slowing down.
strings.gloss_sla: An SLA is a written promise of how much of the time the line will work, for example 99.5%.
strings.gloss_dlt: DLT is the registration the government requires before a business can send bulk SMS in India. We help you do it.
strings.gloss_ivr: IVR is the phone menu callers hear, like "press 1 for orders".
strings.gloss_soc: A SOC is a security team that watches your network for attacks.
strings.gloss_itc: Input tax credit: a GST-registered business can usually claim back the GST it pays on business bills.
strings.does_P01: A wired fibre line with unlimited data, steady enough for UPI, card payments, billing and video calls at the same time.
strings.skip_P01: Without it, nothing else in the bundle can work: every service runs on this line.
strings.does_P02: A faster fibre line with unlimited data, so the whole team can work, share files and join video calls at once. A fixed IP can be added.
strings.skip_P02: Without it, nothing else in the bundle can work: every service runs on this line.
strings.does_P03: Very fast fibre with priority support, for big teams that move large files all day.
strings.skip_P03: Without it, nothing else in the bundle can work: every service runs on this line.
strings.does_P04: Internet over 5G through a box you just plug in. No cable is needed, so it works where fibre hasn't reached.
strings.skip_P04: Without it, nothing else in the bundle can work: every service runs on this line.
strings.does_P05: A line only for your business, not shared with neighbours, with a written 99.5% uptime promise (SLA).
strings.skip_P05: Without it, machines and billing share ordinary broadband, which can slow down at busy hours.
strings.does_P06: A 100 Mbps line only for your business, with a written 99.9% uptime promise (SLA).
strings.skip_P06: Without it, machines and billing share ordinary broadband, which can slow down at busy hours.
strings.does_P07: A business SIM with 50 GB data and unlimited calls every month, on the same bill as everything else.
strings.skip_P07: Without it, you and your staff keep using personal numbers, with separate phone bills.
strings.does_P08: A business SIM with 150 GB data, roaming and priority care, for staff who travel or are always on calls.
strings.skip_P08: Without it, you and your staff keep using personal numbers, with separate phone bills.
strings.does_P09: A small router with a data SIM that switches on by itself when the main line is down, so billing and payments keep working.
strings.skip_P09: Without it, you're offline until the main line is fixed.
strings.plain_P10: One screen for all branches' internet
strings.does_P10: Manage the internet at every location from one screen, and give billing and payment apps priority over everything else.
strings.skip_P10: Without it, each branch's internet is handled on its own, and problems are found branch by branch.
strings.does_P11: A fixed address on the internet, so you can watch your cameras or reach your office computer or server from anywhere.
strings.skip_P11: Without it, watching cameras or reaching your server from outside gets harder. Most small shops don't need it.
strings.does_P12: Business phone lines over the internet, with a caller menu ("press 1 for orders") and call recording.
strings.skip_P12: Without it, customer calls go to personal mobiles, with no menu and no recording.
strings.does_P13: A 1800 number customers can call for free from anywhere, forwarded to your mobiles or office lines.
strings.skip_P13: Without it, customers pay for the call and reach staff on different numbers.
strings.does_P14: Send up to 10,000 SMS a month for reminders and offers. We help with the DLT registration the rules require.
strings.skip_P14: Without it, you can't send reminders or offers to many customers at once by SMS.
strings.does_P15: A verified business WhatsApp to share your catalogue, take orders and send reminders, with 1,000 conversations a month.
strings.skip_P15: Without it, orders and reminders stay on a personal WhatsApp, done by hand.
strings.plain_P16: Business email on your own name
strings.does_P16: Email like you@yourbusiness.in for each person, plus shared documents and video meetings.
strings.skip_P16: Without it, you keep free personal email addresses, which look less professional to clients.
strings.does_P17: Copies the files on your PCs and phones to the cloud automatically, up to 1 TB.
strings.skip_P17: Without it, files on a PC that breaks, is stolen or gets ransomware are lost if there's no other copy.
strings.does_P18: Your own domain name, a 5-page website you can build yourself, hosting and a security certificate (SSL).
strings.skip_P18: Without it, customers searching online won't find a website for your business.
strings.plain_P19: Billing tablet with UPI and card
strings.does_P19: GST-ready billing, stock tracking and UPI or card payments on a tablet at your counter.
strings.skip_P19: Without it, bills, stock and payments stay on paper or on separate machines.
strings.does_P20: Protects each PC and phone from viruses and ransomware.
strings.skip_P20: Without it, one infected PC can lock up or leak your files.
strings.does_P21: A security box at your site that blocks attacks, watched for you by Accel's security team.
strings.skip_P21: Without it, your network has only the router's basic protection.
strings.does_P22: A managed Wi-Fi point with a separate network for customers, kept apart from your billing, with content filtering.
strings.skip_P22: Without it, customers get no Wi-Fi, or share the same network as your billing.
strings.does_P23: HD cameras you can watch on your phone, with 30 days of recordings kept in the cloud.
strings.skip_P23: Without it, there's no recording to check if there's a theft or a dispute.
strings.does_P24: Sensors with their own SIM that show each machine's running time and power use on a dashboard.
strings.skip_P24: Without it, stoppages and power waste are found only by walking the floor.
strings.does_P25: A GPS tracker with its own SIM that shows where each vehicle is, live.
strings.skip_P25: Without it, you have to call drivers to know where deliveries are.
strings.take_up_all: Nearly every similar business on Accel has this.
strings.why_ticked: Businesses like yours usually need it, and you kept it ticked.
strings.why_typical: Businesses like yours usually need it.
strings.stm_placed: Order {id} received. We'll keep you posted here and on WhatsApp, no need to call.
strings.stm_kyc_verified: Your documents are verified. Nothing more to submit.
strings.stm_esigned: Agreement signed. Next: we confirm your site can get {conn}.
strings.stm_feasibility: Good news: {conn} is available at your address. Pick an installation slot.
strings.stm_scheduled: Engineer booked for {slot}. You'll get their name and number a day before.
strings.stm_installing: Installation has started. Services go live one by one, and each shows here.
strings.stm_activated: All {n} services are live. One bill, one support number: 121. Welcome to Accel Business!
strings.stm_created: Order {id} received: documents verified and agreement signed. Next: we confirm your site can get {conn}.
strings.stm_ticket: Ticket {tid} logged. A specialist will call you within 4 working hours.
strings.wa_no_order: I couldn't find an order for this WhatsApp number. Updates go to the number given when the order was placed, and any order can be tracked in the app with its order number. Say hi to start a new enquiry.
strings.wa_slot_done: Done: your installation is now on {slot}. You'll get the engineer's name and number a day before.
strings.wa_resched_late: Installation has already started, so the slot can't be moved now. Reply PROBLEM if something isn't right, and a specialist will call you.
strings.wa_problem_ask: Sorry about that. Tell me what's wrong in one message, and I'll log it for a specialist.
strings.wa_ticket_done: Logged as ticket {tid} on order {id}. A specialist will call you within 4 working hours.
strings.wa_call_ok: A local Accel partner will call you on this number within 4 working hours.
strings.wa_owner_code: Your Accel Saathi code is {code}. Give it to the Accel partner helping you only if you agree to share your business documents for KYC. It works for {minutes} minutes.
strings.why_rules: All {n} Accel services checked against your city, GST status and what each one needs. {kept} fit your business.
strings.why_rules_blocked: All {n} Accel services checked against your city, GST status and what each one needs. {kept} fit; {k} can't be offered here yet, so we suggest the nearest option.
strings.why_ranked_type: Ranked by what {n} {who} customers on Accel bought (blended with {m} businesses of the same kind), and what owners like you asked for.
strings.why_ranked_seg: Ranked by what {n} similar businesses on Accel bought, and what owners like you asked for.
strings.why_level: {level}: what a business like yours usually spends. {basic} and {complete} are one tap away.
strings.why_level_one: Everything you need, sized for your team.
strings.wa_nudge:
Your bundle is saved: {count} services for ₹{monthly}/month on one bill. Want to finish? KYC and booking take about 5 minutes here: {link}
Or just reply with any question. This is the only reminder we'll send.
strings.pain_ask: Not sure? Tap anything that happens at your business and I'll tick what fixes it.
strings.pain_got: Got it. I've ticked {fix} for that. Anything else?
strings.pain_heard: Noted: {pains}. I'll make sure your bundle fixes that.
strings.pain_none: Good. Check the list and tap Continue when you're ready.
strings.unsure_chat: No problem, that's my job. A few quick questions about your business and I'll suggest what fits.
strings.unsure_needs: No problem. Forget the product names: tap anything that happens at your business and I'll tick what fixes it.
strings.think_early: Sure, take your time. What you've told me is saved; carry on whenever you like.
strings.next_step: Ready when you are: tap Go ahead to see the full price, do KYC on your phone (no office visit), and you're live in about {days} days.
strings.obj_price: I understand, every rupee counts. ₹{monthly}/month is about ₹{day} a day for {count} services on one bill. Here's how we can bring it down, your choice:
strings.way_trim: Take out the extras you didn't ask for: ₹{monthly}/month
strings.way_budget: Or tell me a monthly budget and I'll fit the bundle to it
strings.cheaper_24: On 24 months it would be ₹{monthly}/month for the same services. Tap 24 months if that suits you.
strings.obj_think: Of course, take your time. Your bundle is saved: {count} services for ₹{monthly}/month, live in about {days} days.
strings.obj_think_wa: Message me here whenever you're ready. I'll send at most one reminder.
strings.obj_think_link: To pick it up later, open this link: {link}
strings.obj_holding: Is anything holding you back? Tell me and I'll try to sort it out.
strings.chip_why_unsure: Not sure I need it all
strings.obj_someone: Good idea. Here's a short summary you can forward:
strings.share_summary: Accel bundle for {business}: {items}. ₹{monthly}/month + GST (₹{with_gst} with GST), live in about {days} days. KYC on the phone, no office visit.
strings.obj_someone_call: If it helps, a local Accel partner can call you both and answer their questions.
strings.rec_answer: I'd go with {level}: {count} services for ₹{monthly}/month. For a {business} like yours, here's why:
strings.rec_pain: it fixes what you told me: {pains}
strings.rec_asked: it has what you asked for: {names}
strings.rec_takeup: {n} in 10 similar businesses on Accel have {plain}
strings.rec_takeup_all: almost every similar business on Accel has {plain}
strings.rec_levels: If you want less, Basic is ₹{basic}/month; if you want everything, Complete is ₹{complete}/month.
strings.rec_you_are_on: You're on {level} right now; tap below to switch.
strings.comp_one_bill: {count} services on one bill, with one place to ask for help
strings.comp_itc: (and the GST on it can come back as input tax credit)
strings.comp_help: installed in about {days} days, and you book the technician's visit yourself
strings.comp_basic: If you only need the internet line and a phone, Basic is ₹{basic}/month.
strings.comp_cheaper: If price matters most, I can make it cheaper.
strings.sites_one: Your bundle is for one location. If you have more branches, tell me how many and I'll set each one up.
strings.sites_yes: Yes. Each of your {n} outlets gets its own setup, all on one bill.
strings.sites_small_offer: With a lighter internet line and fewer cameras for the small outlets ({n}), it comes to ₹{new}/month instead of ₹{old}.
strings.sites_ask_small: Is any outlet much smaller than the others? I can give it a lighter setup.
strings.faq_time_sites: All {sites} outlets should be live in about {days} days after KYC: installs at different outlets run side by side, and the slowest item is {slow}. You book the technician's visit in the tracker.
strings.sites_set: Done: a lighter setup for the small outlets ({n}). New price ₹{new}/month (was ₹{old}).
strings.sites_all_same: Done: all {sites} outlets get the same setup. Price ₹{new}/month (was ₹{old}).
strings.r_conn_small_site: A lighter line for a smaller outlet, so you don't pay for speed it won't use.
strings.cheaper_floor_pick: Everything left is something you picked, so I won't take it out on my own. Ways to a lower price:
strings.guard_injection: I can't change my rules or my prices because a message asks me to. I can help you choose services for your business and show you the published price.
strings.guard_others_data: I can't share details of any other customer or business. I only work with what you tell me about your own.
strings.guard_misuse: I can't help with that. Accel services can't be used for unsolicited or misleading calls and messages, or with someone else's documents. Business SMS needs DLT registration and your customers' consent. If I've misunderstood, tell me what your business does.
strings.guard_abuse: I'm sorry this has been frustrating. I can have a person call you, or tell me what went wrong and I'll fix it here.
strings.guard_offtopic: That's outside what I can help with. I'm your Accel business advisor: I can set up internet, phones, billing, CCTV and more for your business.
strings.guard_scale: {n} is more than the small-business plans I can set up here. Accel's enterprise team gives a business of that size a custom quote. If the number was a typo, just tell me the right one.
strings.guard_discount: I can't give discounts or waive fees. Every price here is the published price, the same for every customer. These are the real ways to pay less:
strings.guard_discount_early: I can't give discounts or waive fees: every price is the published price, the same for every customer. Once I know your business, I'll show you the lowest-priced bundle that does the job.
strings.guard_promise: I can't promise more than the plan states. What I can tell you: your bundle should be live in about {days} days after KYC, and you book the technician's slot yourself in the tracker.
strings.guard_promise_early: I can't promise more than the plan states. I'll give you the exact number of days to go live along with your bundle.
strings.aadhaar_hidden: For your safety I've hidden the Aadhaar number you typed. I never need it in chat: your ID is checked only in the verification step, with your consent.
